The '''Goblin guard''' (known as '''Sleeping guard''' before being woken up) is a level 28 [[goblin]] who is guarding the kitchen gate in the [[Observatory Dungeon|dungeon]] near the [[Observatory]]. During the [[Observatory Quest]] players must "prod" him to wake him up, he then attacks the player while saying "Oi, how dare you wake me up!". He can be fought after the quest is complete as he respawns in the same place.

*** Tiny spiky bronze salvage → Bronze spear
*** Small plated bronze salvage → Bronze square shield
*** Medium plated bronze salvage → Bronze kiteshield
